$comment: Canonical, agent-agnostic MCP server definitions for this repo. There is no shared cross-agent MCP config format (Claude uses .mcp.json, Codex uses .codex/config.toml TOML), so this neutral file is the single source of truth and `.agents/skills/agent-setup/scripts/render.py` emits each agent's format. No absolute paths, no secrets. Per-user state (Basic Memory vault path, the MLX endpoint) stays out of here.
